# 诊断与健康监测

_Diagnostics & Health Monitoring_

健康监测需要同时考虑状态变化、传感器表现和运行工况。公开仿真模型可以帮助理解部件退化或故障对可测参数的影响，但仍需核对模型与数据的边界。

_Health monitoring must account for changing engine condition, sensor behaviour and operating conditions. Public simulation models help explore measurable effects of deterioration or faults within their stated modelling limits._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 把异常检测、故障定位和寿命预测作为不同任务记录。

_Treat anomaly detection, fault isolation and remaining-life prediction as separate tasks._

- 整理数据来源、工况覆盖和故障定义，避免把工况变化直接当作故障。

_Record data provenance, operating coverage and fault definitions instead of interpreting every operating change as a fault._

- 阅读时对照测量精度、模型误差和验证样本，保留尚未解释的情况。

_Consider measurement accuracy, model error and validation samples, retaining unresolved cases._
